title: Password Reset
content: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.
keyRules: Employees can reset password via self-service portal at any time.
If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT for manual account unlock.
No approval required.

title: VPN Access
content: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.
keyRules: Granted automatically to all full-time employees.
Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form.
VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.

title: Laptop Replacement
content: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.
keyRules: Eligible for replacement after 3 years of service.
Eligible earlier only in case of verified hardware failure.
Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.

title: Software Installation Requests
content: Standard software (listed in the approved catalog) can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.
keyRules: Standard software in approved catalog can be self-installed.
Non-catalog software requires IT Security review.
IT Security review turnaround is 3–5 business days.

title: Printer Troubleshooting
content: For printer issues, first check the printer queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer’s asset tag.
keyRules: First step: check printer queue and restart print spooler.
If issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.

title: Email Mailbox Quota
content: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.
keyRules: Default mailbox quota is 25GB.
Employees nearing quota should archive old mail.
Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval.
Quota increases are capped at 50GB.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
content: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.
keyRules: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours.
Can be generated by any employee directly from front-desk kiosk.
No IT ticket required.

title: Expense Software Access
content: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account already exists.
keyRules: Access to expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT.
IT can assist with login/technical issues only once an account already exists.

title: Security Incident Reporting
content: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and should not be forwarded to other employees.
keyRules: Report immediately to security@veridian-corp.example.
Must not be forwarded to other employees.
Applies to suspected phishing, malware, or unauthorized access attempts.

title: Work-From-Home Equipment
content: Employees working remotely more than 3 days/week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance (chair, monitor). Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing — IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved.
keyRules: Eligible if working remotely more than 3 days/week.
One-time home office equipment allowance covers chair, monitor.
Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing.
IT only handles equipment shipping request once approved.

title: Asset Management Policy (Extract)
content: Issued by Finance & Assets, last updated Q2 2026. All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
keyRules: Standard 4-year refresh cycle from date of issue for all company-issued hardware (laptops, monitors).
Early replacement outside this 4-year cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
